candidates.title: Civitai prompt 145429896
candidates.prompt:
WORLD / SCENE IDENTITY

Masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic. A quiet rural farmhouse in late autumn, surrounded by dry grass, bare shrubs, sparse golden trees, and a field filled with large harvested pumpkins.

The atmosphere feels rustic, seasonal, slightly whimsical, and gently eerie without becoming horror.

MAIN ANCHOR

One small ghost-like figure stands among the pumpkins in the foreground-middle ground.

Use a simple white sheet-like form with:

soft natural folds,
two small dark oval eye openings,
rounded upper silhouette,
and fabric falling almost to the ground.

Keep the figure small and charming rather than frightening.

PUMPKIN FIELD

Surround the figure with many large orange pumpkins scattered irregularly through the dry field.

Use:

warm orange,
muted ochre,
deep pumpkin brown,
dark stems,
and natural differences in size and shape.

Avoid evenly spaced or identical pumpkins.

VISUAL ROUTE

Build one clear visual route:

foreground pumpkins
-> white ghost figure
-> dry autumn field
-> old farmhouse
-> golden trees
-> pale overcast sky.

The bright white figure should create the strongest local contrast against the warm field.

FARMHOUSE

Use one old rural two-story farmhouse in the background.

Use:

weathered pale wooden siding,
steep simple roof,
brick chimney,
covered front porch,
dark windows,
old steps,
and slightly neglected garden edges.

Keep the house practical and aged rather than overtly haunted.

CAMERA

Use a vertical environmental composition from natural standing height.

Keep the ghost slightly off-center and the farmhouse clearly visible behind it.

Preserve enough pumpkin field in the foreground to establish depth.

FOREGROUND

Use:

large pumpkins,
dry grasses,
corn stalk remnants,
fallen leaves,
dark weeds,
and patches of exposed soil.

Keep the nearest pumpkins most resolved.

MIDDLE GROUND

The ghost and main pumpkin cluster occupy the strongest focal plane.

Use broad dry grasses around them with enough negative space for the white silhouette to remain clear.

BACKGROUND

Use:

the farmhouse,
bare tree branches,
remaining orange foliage,
dark shrubs,
and a pale muted autumn sky.

Keep the background quieter than the foreground.

LIGHT

Use broad soft late-autumn daylight.

Warm light softly reaches:

pumpkins,
dry grasses,
farmhouse siding,
remaining orange leaves,
and selected folds of the white fabric.

Shadows remain open in muted brown, olive, and blue-gray.

COLOR

BASE:
dry grass beige,
weathered wood gray,
muted olive,
soft autumn brown.

COUNTER:
pumpkin orange,
warm ochre,
rust,
soft cream.

ACCENT:
the white ghost figure and small dark eye openings.

DEPTH

Create depth through:

foreground pumpkin overlap,
ghost placement,
field recession,
house scale,
tree layering,
and atmospheric softening toward the background.

GLOBAL VISUAL LANGUAGE

Preserve one clear visual thesis:

a small white ghost-like figure stands quietly among a field of orange pumpkins in front of an old rural farmhouse during late autumn.

The pumpkins provide seasonal identity.

The ghost provides the playful anomaly.

The farmhouse provides rural context.

Keep the scene painterly, rustic, autumnal, slightly uncanny, and immediately readable at thumbnail scale.

PAINTERLY STYLE

A flat hand-drawn graphic illustration, 2000s.

candidates.title: Civitai prompt 145437582
candidates.prompt: A lone warrior stands rooted in a quiet, desolate landscape—perhaps a misty field at dawn or the edge of a dark, wet shoreline. He is clad in heavy, subtly weathered armor, drawing back a recurve bowstring, his posture conveying immense, contained tension and weary resolve. Surrounding him, erupting from the ground like tormented spirit smoke, are chaotic streams of dark, viscous energy—these tendrils are rendered with the fluid grace of traditional Japanese ink wash (Sumi-e). Embedded within these swirling forms are multiple demonic visages; their expressions are fiercely stylized—sharp angles, exaggerated brow ridges, and wide, knowing grins characteristic of oni or vengeful spirits. The lighting is weak morning light filtering through a heavy layer of mist, casting soft, melancholic shadows that pool around the warrior’s boots. The composition frames the warrior centrally, but the explosive energy behind him forces the eye outward into the negative space—the quiet emptiness of the landscape speaks louder than any battle cry. Focus on the contrast: the grounded, tangible weight of the warrior versus the ephemeral, stylized agony of the spectral faces. Skin textures must be hyper-realistic yet possess a subtle, painted quality (like aged wood or rice paper).
